text: Henrik's dad died on Sunday. The funeral is on 2 November 2026 in Aarhus and he's flying out the day before. I should text him that morning.
Sinead and her boyfriend have split up after six years. She's staying with her sister Caitlin for now and sounded completely wrung out.
Viewing a two-bed flat on Elm Grove on Saturday at 11. Need to bring payslips and the reference letter.

Jun has been made redundant. The consultation meeting was last Thursday and his final day is the end of November. He seemed oddly calm about it, but his wife Heather is worried sick. They've only just remortgaged, and she's been doing extra shifts at the hospital to cover the gap. She asked me to keep an eye on him at five-a-side, since he won't talk to her about it.
Kate is moving to Glasgow in March 2027 for the new job. She hasn't found anywhere to live yet and wants to view flats the week after Easter.
Oliver's grandmother passed away on Tuesday. He was very close to her. Don't forget to send a card to his parents as well.
Bins go out on Wednesday now, not Thursday. New council schedule.

Talked to Javier after the service. His mum, Mrs Fernández, is holding up better than expected, but his younger brother Louis hasn't said a word to anyone since. Javier thinks Louis needs to get away for a bit and is taking him to Valencia the week after the burial.
Claire's leaving drinks are on Friday. She took the voluntary redundancy package in the end and seems relieved more than anything.
Blessing finally got the keys to her new place in Leeds! She moves in on 14 December 2026 and is planning a housewarming in January.

Gareth and Barbara are separating. The house goes on the market next month and she's taking the dog, Biscuit. Gareth is renting a studio near his work in the meantime. I must ring him next week, he sounded low. He kept saying he should have seen it coming, and that his kids are taking it harder than he expected.
Elif's uncle's funeral was yesterday. She said the eulogy went fine but she couldn't stop shaking afterwards.
Esme is obsessed with pottery at the moment and has her own wheel in the spare room.
Remind me to ask Rebecca how the flat viewing in Bristol went. It was on Monday and she'd been really hopeful about it.
Fatima's brother Yosef lost his job at the warehouse. He's applying everywhere but hasn't had a single interview yet. She said he's been sleeping until noon and she's worried about him.

Agnieszka is moving back to Kraków in the new year. Her mum's health has got worse and she wants to be closer. The flight is booked for 6 January 2027, and her lease here ends the week before. She'd like help packing the weekend before Christmas, and I've already said yes. Her flatmate Magda is taking over the room.
Paolo Rossi's wedding is off. He and Uma broke up in August, apparently. He's moving out of their flat at the end of the month.
Pooja's cat Mango has to be put to sleep on Thursday. She's in bits. Text her that evening.
Finn starts at the new firm on 3 November 2026 after nearly four months out of work. I should send him something the day before to wish him well.
Keisha's nan died in the night. Keisha is driving up to Birmingham this afternoon, and the funeral will probably be the following week. Her partner Jonah is staying behind with the kids.
Aoife mentioned she's been looking at houses in Cork. Nothing definite yet, but she's sick of renting in Dublin.

Amy and her husband are moving to Manchester on 21 November 2026. The removal van comes that morning and they're doing the final clean the day after. They'd love a hand with the boxes beforehand if anyone's free.
Saanvi said her parents are coming over from Pune for Christmas and staying until mid-January. Her dad loves cricket and will be glad of company to watch it with.
Angela's husband is going in for heart surgery on Tuesday. She'll be at the hospital all day and asked if I could pick the kids up from school that afternoon. Already said I would.
Note to self: renew the contents insurance before the move on the 30th.
Henrik said the funeral went as well as these things can. His sister Magda did a reading and his mum managed the wake afterwards. Need to check in with him at the weekend.
Called Heather back. Jun has an interview at the council on Friday and he's quite nervous, which isn't like him. She asked me not to mention the redundancy if I see him.
Kate rang from the train. The flat in Finnieston fell through, so she's viewing two more on 9 March 2027 and will decide by the end of that week.
Gareth sounded much better today. He's joined a running club and is training for the Cardiff half in March 2027. Barbara has apparently moved in with her sister.
Oliver doesn't eat red meat. Worth remembering for the wake if I'm helping with food.

Spent ages on the phone with Sinead. She's decided to leave London altogether and move home to Galway by the spring. Her ex, Finn, is keeping the flat. Her mum is thrilled and has already cleared out the old bedroom. Sinead is worried about finding work over there, though, and wants to start applying before Christmas. Her friend Aoife has offered to put her up in Dublin for a few weeks first.
Rebecca got the flat! Contracts signed this morning and she moves on 1 December 2026. Buy her a plant or something for the new place.
Claire mentioned that her old manager, Gareth Smith, is also on the redundancy list. He has two kids at uni and is really struggling with the uncertainty.

Jonah's mum is in hospital with pneumonia. He's been visiting every evening after work and looks exhausted. Their eldest, Esme, has her school play next week and he's terrified he'll miss it. Keisha has her own deadline at work that Friday, so neither of them can easily get away. I offered to film it if it comes to that.

Long chat with Blessing about the move. Her landlord in London is refusing to return the deposit, she's started a new role in Leeds on 1 December, and her brother Louis is driving the van up the weekend before. She wants me to come up for the housewarming on 16 January 2027. Don't forget to book trains early.
Javier says his dog Pepa is struggling with the stairs in the new house. Vet appointment on Monday.
Uma Banerjee is the best person to ask about letting agents in Bristol. She used to work for one.
Paolo is coping, just about. He took a week off after the breakup and spent it at his parents' in Turin. He's back at work now but said the evenings are the worst.
Moving day went fine. Still no internet until Thursday, so working from the café.
Need to message Agnieszka the day after she lands in Kraków to check she arrived safely.
Elif's grandfather, Dede, turns ninety on 12 April 2027. The whole family is going to Izmir for it. She said he'd love a framed photo of the old shop.
Finn's girlfriend Keisha told me he'd been made redundant back in June and hadn't told his parents for weeks. Glad the new job came through. They're celebrating with dinner on Saturday.
Barbara's mother passed away on 28 October 2026. The funeral is the following Thursday. Gareth is going, even though they're separated, which I think is kind of him.
Fatima's family are moving from Leicester to Nottingham to be near her in-laws. Her son Jun starts at the new school after half term and is dreading it.
Yosef seemed brighter. He's started volunteering at the food bank and has a second interview there next week.
Pooja buried Mango in the garden on Friday. She said the house feels empty. Maybe take her out for lunch at some point next week.
Amy said the new neighbours in Manchester are lovely. Her daughter Saanvi has already made friends with the kids next door.
Angela texted. The surgery went well and her husband should be home by Sunday. She's still exhausted but sounded relieved.
Must call Aunt Angela on 2 November 2026. It would have been Uncle Louis's seventieth and it's her first one without him.
Oliver said his brother Henrik is moving to Oslo next year to be with his girlfriend. Their mum isn't taking it well.

Keisha said the funeral was beautiful. Jonah came up the day before with the kids, and afterwards the family went to the pub her nan used to run. She's going back up in two weeks to help clear the house. Her cousins want to sell it quickly but Keisha would rather keep it in the family for a while. That's going to be a hard conversation for all of them.
Remind me to send Sinead the number for that removals company. She's moving at the end of March 2027.
Kate likes cold-water swimming and has already found a club on Loch Lomond.
Claire's first day at the charity is 10 November 2026. She's nervous about going from a big corporate to a team of six.
Rebecca's housewarming has been cancelled because the boiler broke. She's hoping to reschedule for January.
Heather and Jun are celebrating their tenth wedding anniversary on 5 December 2026. Jun wants to surprise her with a weekend in Edinburgh and asked me not to say anything.
Dr Popescu said the results should be back within a fortnight. Ring the surgery if I haven't heard by then.

Caitlin mentioned that Sinead has been crying at work and her manager has noticed. Caitlin is worried about her but doesn't know how to bring it up. I should take Sinead for a coffee this week, away from everything.
Viewing went badly. The flat was smaller than the photos and right above a takeaway. Back to the search.

Magda's dad died very suddenly last week. She's flying to Gdańsk tomorrow and isn't sure when she'll be back. Her partner Paolo is going out the day after. Send flowers to her flat before she returns, and text Paolo to ask whether they need anything sorting at this end.
